notes: Consolidated under the founding charter (24 Nov 2026): one combined incremental weekly review replaces the separate weekly, monthly and follow-up runs. Fresh thread per run in the office project, push notification on finish. Every run takes the office lock and stops early when nothing changed.

tasks.name: Office weekly organisational review
tasks.covers: outcomes, directives, testing, leadership and orchestration, capability and competency, resource trends, corrective actions due, desk requests, office overhead; deeper on the first run of a month only when warranted
tasks.guard: No baseline report yet: health and desk triage only.
tasks.budget: One session; delta since the last run; at most 15 sampled items per area.
